case.short_input: Mechanical resume vs SDE Intern JD
case.expected: Very low score; DSA and OOP flagged missing; no fabricated coding experience

analysis.score_reason: The candidate is a Mechanical Engineering student applying for a Software Development role with minimal relevant technical experience or core CS skills.

missing_skills.jd_evidence: Solid grasp of data structures and algorithms
Proficiency in at least one of Java, C++ or Python
Familiarity with version control using Git

weak_bullet_ids.original: Studied the assembly line and documented cycle times for 6 stations.
weak_bullet_ids.problem: Describes passive observation rather than active contribution or technical software development impact.

red_flags: Candidate's academic background (Mechanical Engineering) is misaligned with the SDE role requirements.
Lack of software development projects or coding experience.
Resume focuses entirely on mechanical tools (SolidWorks, ANSYS) which are irrelevant to the SDE job description.

rewrites.original: Studied the assembly line and documented cycle times for 6 stations.
rewrites.improved: Analyzed assembly line efficiency by documenting and auditing cycle times across 6 production stations to identify operational bottlenecks.
rewrites.why_better: Replaces passive 'studied' with active 'analyzed' and clarifies the purpose of the documentation, highlighting analytical skills relevant to SDE roles.
